items.title: Eddie Morris Interview, 1958-12-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Do you remember many of the guitar players that played sacred songs, spirituals like Blind Willie Johnson? ... [INTERVIEWEE] North of the world. You mean like singing to them spirituality churches?

ctx.x: Yeah. Well, I tell you, heaps of time, them fellas mostly would play blues and things and get around them ballrooms with light at that liquor world. You may find anything around there. Them kind of players.

Do you remember many of the guitar players that played sacred songs, spirituals like Blind Willie Johnson? He worked on the streets and all sometimes. I think he was here a while. Any of those singers from the churches that...
North of the world. You mean like singing to them spirituality churches?
